title: Only a couple of complaints so far
body:
I have only had this laptop for a few weeks, but so far, I like it. The display is nice and it seems to be powerful enough for what I need it to do. 
My biggest complaints are as follows:
1.) when I received this, it was missing the power cord. I called customer support and they could not send me a power cord. They wanted me to mail back the entire laptop to send me a new one. A $20 cord wasn't worth the hassle for me so I kept it and got my own cord. 
2.) There are a lot of pop up HP reminders and such trying to either sell me something or remind me of something it thinks I should do (like install their security app). I went through and turned off all the notifications I could find and it's better now. But I still get some pop ups/messages on screen. 
3.) It is HEAVY. You wouldn't think 5lbs would be that heavy, but it is. I love the big display since I am getting old and my eyesight sucks, but this is not a laptop you'd want to travel with or take anywhere. The size isn't so much a barrier as I just wouldn't want to lug it around and would likely have to sacrifice half my wardrobe to keep my luggage within the weight limits. 
But over it is a very nice computer. Very similar to the computer I use at work so it feels seamless from work to home. 
I am happy with my purchase although now I think I could have gone down one size and been okay, but I have no regrets.
product_name: HP OmniBook X Copilot+ PC 17.3" FHD Touch, Glacier Silver

title: Overall great laptop...
body:
Where do I start... 

PROs:
Performance - Exceptional in terms of speed and transitions from one webpage and/or software to the next. 

Visuals/Display - Great picture, nice color and pixel quality. 

Design - Nice large touchscreen that has great accuracy, and love the backlit keyboard with 10-key.

Sound - Great quality, clear, good base for laptop. 

CONs:
Performance - After 1 week, seemed to have an internal issue that caused the system to reboot without warning or a valid reason.  Seems to have resolved itself, but if it happens again, bringing in for Total Service care/replacement. 

Design - Keyboard is not like standard keyboard, in that, keys are much bigger and seems to be missing the CTRL key on the right side of keyboard.  |  The matte exterior hard-shell finish marks up easily, but also wipes away easily.

title: Great laptop!  (but heavy)
body: This laptop is truly a workhorse, it's got 32 gigs of RAM and 2 TB of storage.  It boots up fast, and it's handled everything I've thrown at it so far. The speakers are actually okay, not the best, but they definitely get the job done.  The very latge screen is just fine as well, as I love the touch screen.  I  really have no complaints other than it's the heaviest laptop that I've used in many years back when they used to be ridiculously heavy.  If you have it plugged in on a table most of the time like we do, it's fine.  If you're planning on lugging it everyday all around, you have to take that into consideration.  However, in the end, this was one of the few laptops I could find that offered high levels of Ram and storage, as well as a backlit numeric keyboard, a touch screen, and a new processor.  We're extremely happy with it.
